attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense/Unbound) as the DNS resolver for the shared private network. node2 and node3 now use node1 (10.100.109.10) as their nameserver, resolving all domains normally except blocked.example and every subdomain under it, which return NXDOMAIN (via an Unbound DNSBL custom wildcard policy with nxdomain=1). Verified with raw DNS queries (rcode=3/NXDOMAIN, 0 answers) versus normal domains (rcode=0 with answers). All three nodes were individually restarted via native reboot, boot identities were proven to change, and post-restart DNS service/config/blocking behavior was verified as fully recovered on each.
